lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots; a prominent cluster of three spots is visible in the mid-lateral region directly posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-anterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small elongated teleost with a dark lateral stripe in the lower-left foreground, and five distinct vertical gill slits positioned anterior to the pectoral fin.
